gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (Europe)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB: a DeSmuME .dsv of the 512 B EEPROM (512 bytes and the 122-byte footer: size 512, padSize 512, type 0, addr_size 1) padded with 0xFF

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-dsv.py step0.bin step1.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step1.bin --chip 512 --stem 'Bomberman (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; cuts the DeSmuME footer; fits it to the 512-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
